title: Canonical finite-free internal Hom evaluation coordinates
statement: Use the ordinary small-etale derived module categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], their published closed internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and derived scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. In a monoidal closed category with finite products, for vectors $e_i:1\to K$, $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(t)$, define $\operatorname{coord}_{e,N}:H(K,N)\to\prod_iN$ by component $\operatorname{ev}\circ(e_i\otimes1)\circ\lambda^{-1}$. On a scheme $T$ and commutative coefficient ring $R$, use the standard constant-sheaf functor and its canonical derived unit identification $1\simeq R_T[0]$. The standard vectors $R_T[0]\to(R^t)_T[0]$ are constant-sheaf images of $a\mapsto a e_i$, placed in degree zero. Transport them through a chosen trivialization $K\simeq(R^t)_T[0]$, then use the preceding coordinates. Rank zero uses the empty product. These definitions specify maps, without asserting invertibility or making an arbitrary choice of coordinates.
